-- Index of the last occurrence of k in keys, or -1 if absent.
last_index(keys: List[str], k: str) -> int =
  var found = -1
  for i in range(0, keys.len())
    if keys[i] == k
      found = i
  found

-- True when k appears in keys before position i.
seen_before(keys: List[str], i: int) -> bool =
  var hit = False
  for j in range(0, i)
    if keys[j] == keys[i]
      hit = True
  hit

settings(keys: List[str], values: List[str]) -> List[str] =
  pre keys.len() == values.len()
  post out.len() >= 2
  ex settings([], []) == ["fast", "3"]
  ex settings(["level"], ["5"]) == ["fast", "5"]
  ex settings(["mode", "theme"], ["slow", "dark"]) == ["slow", "3", "dark"]
  var mode = "fast"
  var level = "3"
  let mi = last_index(keys, "mode")
  if mi >= 0
    mode = values[mi]
  let li = last_index(keys, "level")
  if li >= 0
    level = values[li]
  var out: List[str] = [mode, level]
  for i in range(0, keys.len())
    let k = keys[i]
    if k != "mode" and k != "level" and not seen_before(keys, i)
      let last = last_index(keys, k)
      out = out + [values[last].copy()]
  out
